detail: The 20-second outer tool window timed out while typesetting the evidence guide. The partial PDF was not accepted. The subsequent complete rebuild replaced it.
All three documents compiled, but mechanical preflight detected one 31.01-point overfull line in the long source-module paragraph. The paragraph was replaced by a readable concordance reference.

The build log reached its successful mechanical-check message, but the outer tool invocation reported a timeout. It was not used as terminal end-to-end evidence. A supervised build then returned exit code zero with a durable receipt.

The contents split immediately after the Part V title; the bibliography and evidence guide each had a short trailing continuation. The contents were balanced before Part IV, editorial policy was moved beside source concordance, and the reproduction conclusion was tightened. Final pages were rerendered.
